summary: Answered all four of the owner's 19 Nov notes on three channels and, at the owner's word, applied them straight away instead of testing: every Paisa Panchayat Short shows the real face or logo in its hook, geography maps trace the country in a glowing line and cover it with its flag, and the tech channel speaks faster. Lint now also checks each Short follows its test group.
why: Owner notes come first (policy), and the owner said live on 19 Nov: 'The feedback I have goes straight away, don't add it as a test.' No experiment matured: Paisa Panchayat's cycle 1 had 2 of 8 Shorts a side with data when it was closed; long tests 1 and 2 of 4.

findings.title: Paisa Panchayat cycle 1 closed before its verdict
findings.detail: real-subject-first-frame had 2 of 8 Shorts a side with 48 h data (on 9, off 2) when the owner asked for feedback to apply straight away; adopted without a measured result.

findings.title: Cycle 1's groups were partly mixed
findings.detail: On side without a real photo in the hook: v-20261114-03, v-20261116-02, v-20261119-12 (Squid Game). Off side with one: v-20261117-02. The director step never read the test's instruction.

findings.title: Long tests wait
findings.detail: quiet-bed 1 of 4 long videos per arm, chart-gap-fill 2 of 4.

findings.title: Impact, week of 2026-11-09 (Paisa Panchayat)
findings.detail: 17 Shorts: median 48 h views 207, 71.6% viewed, stayed to watch 0.339, 20.6 s average view (week of 2026-11-02: 43 views, 50.6%, 0.381).

findings.title: New channels
findings.detail: Geography, tech and business have no Shorts with 48 h data yet. Geography now makes 2 Shorts a day, enough for a cycle; tech makes 1 (owner informed).

changes.title: Real photo or logo in every Short's hook (Paisa Panchayat)
changes.detail: Cycle 1 real-subject-first-frame closed early and adopted: writer.md 'The first frame', director.md, cycle/recipe.json. Copyrighted posters and show logos stay off.

changes.title: Border trace and flag fill on the maps (geography)
changes.detail: remotion/src/flat/map.tsx Fill.trace (a glowing line runs round the border and closes) and Fill.flag (the country covered by its flag, mainland bounds, 3:2 cover, thin countries stretched along their length); remotion/src/flat/flags.tsx draws about 60 flags (FlagSheet in Root); director.md. Checked on stills.

changes.title: Faster voice (tech)
changes.detail: generator/pack.py OWNER_PACE: the tech channel's Shorts speak at 1.0 instead of channel.json's 0.92; checklist counts words at ~164 a minute.

changes.title: Lint checks each Short follows its test group (all channels)
changes.detail: generator/experiments.py adherence_problems for tests with a `check`; director.md prints the video's side first. 4 Shorts in cycle 1 had broken their group.
